claire-docs: Heads-up: my docs PR (#456) failed the site build on CI. Error: duplicate anchor 'overview' and two images 404 only in CI. Works fine locally on mac. Anyone seen this cross-OS behavior? build-bot: build-bot: docs-site build failed: Error: duplicate anchor 'overview' at /docs/guide/overview.md:21 nate-frontend: This is usually slug normalization. Emoji-prefixed headings and plain headings can collapse to the same slug depending on Node's ICU. claire-docs: I compared the two headings and one contains an invisible char (ZWSP) after the word. On mac my editor hid it, CI's linux container slugifies differently so Docusaurus complains. oliver-infra: For images: CI doesn't include symlink targets we kept in `docs/static/` (they pointed to `../assets/diagrams`). The 404s are because the tar/context used by GH Actions didn't follow symlinks. maya-qa: Linkcheck output: `linkcheck: 3 broken links, missing images: /static/img/flow.png, /static/img/arch.svg`. Also HTML validator flagged duplicate ids. nate-frontend: Short fixes we can do in this PR: (1) remove the invisible char or add an explicit id: `

Overview

`, (2) vendor-copy the two diagrams into `docs/static/img/` for now. oliver-infra: Long-term infra options: update workflow to dereference links before build: `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` or use `tar --dereference` when packaging. I'll open a tiny workflow PR for that. maya-qa: If you vendor-copy, please add a checksum test in `docs/tests` so we detect drift. I'll add `yarn docs:linkcheck` to our local test runner. nate-frontend: Also propose a config tweak: set `slugify: s => require('github-slugger').slug(s)` in docusaurus config so anchors match GitHub and reduce surprises between README and site. Add `remark-unique-headers` to fail on duplicates before build. claire-docs: Plan: I'll strip the hidden char and vendor-copy images for this PR to unblock. Then we follow up with infra/workflow + slugger + lint. I'll ping for QA once CI reruns. oliver-infra: I'll draft the workflow change (rsync -aL) and add a failure helper that prints file:line for duplicate anchors to make fixes quick. maya-qa: Sounds good. Ping me once PR is up and I'll run linkcheck locally. :thumbsup: nate-frontend: Small doc ask: can we add a note to CONTRIBUTING.md: "avoid symlinks inside docs/static; prefer shared assets or vendor-copy"? Prevents future confusion. claire-docs: Will add that note in the follow-up. Thanks all, opening the PR now.
